children: Lifeward posted an investor presentation highlighting $21.8M LTM revenue, pipeline timelines and a strategic Oramed partnership.
Posted investor presentation to website to be used with analysts and investors, disclosing strategy and metrics.
$21.8M LTM revenue (as of June 30, 2026) with Q2 revenue up 16% YoY and $11M cash MRQ noted.
Oramed partnership provides up to $47M milestone funding, $10M received in March 2026 and pre-funded POD development.
Established reimbursement moat: HCPCS code, ~46% Medicare Advantage coverage and $95,081 Medicare fee schedule rate.
Product pipeline with anticipated launches post-FDA clearance: StrideSense (2027), upper-body exoskeleton (2028), ReWalk X (2029).
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
